classes.IShape:
Public Name As String
Public Function Area() As Double
End Function
Public Sub Grow(ByVal f As Double)
End Sub
classes.CSquare:
Implements IShape
Public Side As Double
Private mName As String
Private Function IShape_Area() As Double
IShape_Area = Side * Side
End Function
Private Sub IShape_Grow(ByVal f As Double)
Side = Side * f
End Sub
Private Property Get IShape_Name() As String
IShape_Name = "sq:" & mName
End Property
Private Property Let IShape_Name(ByVal v As String)
mName = v
End Property
Public Function Area() As String
Area = "own area"
End Function

probes.name: call_through_interface
probes.macro:
Private Function Describe(ByVal sh As IShape) As String
Describe = TypeName(sh) & ":" & sh.Area
End Function
Private Function AsShape(ByVal sq As CSquare) As IShape
Set AsShape = sq
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim s As New CSquare, sh As IShape
s.Side = 3
Set sh = s
Probe = sh.Area & "|" & s.Area
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim c As New Collection, sh As IShape, s As CSquare, t As Double
Set s = New CSquare: s.Side = 1: c.Add s
Set s = New CSquare: s.Side = 2: c.Add s
For Each sh In c
t = t + sh.Area
Next
Probe = t
End Function
